register.labelZh: BE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: be on、be away、be booked up 和 be out of something 可以幫助你清楚談論活動、外出、預訂和物資。；be behind somebody 表示支持;be after something 和 be out for something 則可以描述某人想得到或決心取得的事物。；be into something、be over somebody 和 be over something 可以幫助你自然地談論興趣、感情、疾病和康復。；這些 BE 表達常見於電話通話、預訂訊息、職場對話、新聞報道和日常英語。
register.summaryEn: Expressions such as be on, be away, be booked up and be out of something help you talk clearly about events, travel, reservations and supplies. Be behind somebody shows support, while be after something and be out for something describe what a person wants or is determined to achieve. Be into something, be over somebody and be over something help you discuss interests, relationships, illness and recovery naturally. These BE expressions often appear in telephone calls, booking messages, workplace conversations, news reports and everyday speech.
contextsZh: 使用 BE 描述計劃、空位和日常情況
表達興趣、康復和感情變化
contextsEn: Use BE to describe plans, availability and everyday situations
Talk about support, goals and progress
Express interests, recovery and emotional change
register.formalZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 BE 片語動詞。
register.formalEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the BE expression that gives the same meaning.

fixedVariable.fixedZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 BE 片語動詞。
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the BE expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；幾個表達的外形十分相似。請仔細留意 BE 後面的內容。；be over somebody 表示已從感情傷痛中恢復;be through with somebody 則表示已結束關係或不再來往。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Several expressions look similar. Read what follows BE carefully: The party is on. Dinner is on me. Ben is on antibiotics. The police are onto Ben. Be over somebody means that the emotional pain has ended. Be through with somebody means that the relationship or contact has ended.
